cards.name: Annex usage: weekly users per app (12 weeks)
cards.sql: SELECT week, app, users FROM annex_ops.usage_weekly WHERE week >= date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Ljubljana')::date - 77 ORDER BY week, app

cards.name: Annex usage: requests per day per app (30 days)
cards.sql: SELECT day, app, requests FROM annex_ops.usage_daily WHERE day > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Ljubljana')::date - 30 ORDER BY day, app

cards.name: Annex usage: last 7 days per app (users, errors, response time)
cards.sql: SELECT app, users_7d, requests_7d, round(error_rate_7d * 100, 1) AS error_rate_pct, p95_7d AS p95_ms FROM annex_ops.usage_apps ORDER BY requests_7d DESC, app

cards.name: Annex usage: graduation candidates and dormant apps
cards.sql: SELECT app, signal, users_7d, week1, week2, week3, week4, last_used FROM annex_ops.usage_apps WHERE signal IS NOT NULL ORDER BY signal, app
